title: Operator 5
body: A road sign reads OPERATOR 5 — NEXT LEFT. VANTABLACK says the sign is not for you. The voice comes from the back seat.

outcome.text: The back seat is empty, but a memory card is buckled in. Its label is your employee number.
The sign changes to OPERATOR 5 — TOO LATE. The memory card is waiting in the glove box.
